== Biography ==
He was born or baptized on 03 January 1827 in Athelstaneford, Haddingtonshire, Scotland and was the son of [[Scott-41744|Agnes (Scott)]] and [[Glasgow-1450|Peter Glasgow]]. <ref> Church of Scotland: Old Parish Registers - Births and Baptisms citing [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/   ScotlandsPeople]; National Records of Scotland; citing Parish#703; ref#30/26; frame#557; for John Glasgow, born or baptised: 21 Jan 1827 Athelstaneford, Haddingtonshire, Scotland (parents: Peter Glasgow & Agnes Scott) </ref>

John Peter Glasgow married 20 June 1856 at Spring Gardens, Haddington, Haddingtonshire, Scotland to Janet Peffers. <ref> Marriage record citing [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/   ScotlandsPeople]; National Records of Scotland; Statutory Register of Marriages; ref#709/2/6; reg: 1856 Haddington Landward District; m: 20 Jun 1856 Haddington for Peter Glasgow & Janet Peffers; gives his name as Peter which is his father's name and would appear to be an error. All other sources gives his name as John </ref> 

He died on 22 April 1887 at TempleHall, Pencaitland, Haddingtonshire, Scotland. <ref> Statutory Register of Deaths citing [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/   ScotlandsPeople]; National Records of Scotland; ref#716/5; for John Glasgow, d: 1887 Pencaitland, Haddingtonshire, Scotland @59yrs </ref>
